# Ojasio | Premium Nutrition & Wellness

## Overview
Ojasio is a premium global wellness and nutrition brand founded by Disha Arora, a Certified Nutrition Manager. We specialize in evidence-based, scientifically rigorous, and individualized nutritional architectures designed for busy executives, working professionals, and those seeking true metabolic rehabilitation. We provide pragmatic, root-cause resolution strategies.

## Services Offered
- Clinical Weight Management
- Advanced Diabetes Control & Insulin Resistance Reversal
- PCOS & Hormonal Balance Protocols
- Executive Wellness & Corporate Nutrition
- Strategic Lean Mass Building
- Pre and Post-Pregnancy Nourishment

## Target Audience
Busy professionals, business executives, international clients (NRIs), and individuals seeking sustainable, clinical-grade health transformations without starvation diets. We offer culturally aligned meal variations worldwide.

## Expert Profile
Disha Arora is a highly qualified Certified Nutrition Manager and the visionary behind Ojasio. She emphasizes deep physiological resetting and healing over superficial calorie-counting mathematics.
